question: The Yakshagana is the dance-drama primarily associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yakshagana** is a traditional dance-drama form that originated in the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• This art form combines dance, music, dialogue, costume, make-up, and stage techniques with a unique style and form.
 
• Yakshagana is traditionally presented from dusk to dawn and is associated with the coastal and Malnad regions of Karnataka.
 
• The themes of Yakshagana are usually drawn from Hindu epics such as the Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Puranas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Yakshagana** literally means the song (gana) of the Yaksha (nature spirits).
 
• It is believed to have evolved from pre-classical music and theatre during the Bhakti movement.
 
• Yakshagana performances are known for their vibrant costumes, elaborate headgear, and face painting, which are integral elements of the art form.
 
• There are different styles of Yakshagana, such as **Badagutittu** and **Tenkutittu**, which are distinguished by variations in dance, music, and costume.
